description: This file defines the PHP class SugarCacheMemcached, which implements caching functionality using Memcached for the SuiteCRM application. It extends an abstract cache class and manages connection to a Memcached server, providing methods to set, get, clear, and reset cached data.

classes.name: SugarCacheMemcached
classes.description: A class implementing caching using Memcached for SuiteCRM, managing connection and cache operations.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if the Memcached backend can be used based on extension availability and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache object by calling parent constructor.

methods.name: _getMemcachedObject
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the Memcached object, setting server host and port from configuration.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Sets a value in the Memcached cache with a specific key.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the Memcached cache for a specific key.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the Memcached cache.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Clears all cache entries in the Memcached server.
